job.purpose: Field presence check (Head of R&D order 21:12Z, Main approved): does the candlesticks answer for the 11 NC15 non-crypto 15 minute markets carry open_interest_fp, populated? One batched GET, one recent window (close 2026-11-13T19:00Z). Only open_interest_fp is read; no price, book, trade or result column.
job.heldout: None held out by this job. It is a field-presence check, not a test: no outcome is joined, no rule is scored, zero tries. The window (close 2026-11-13T19:00Z) lies inside NC15's recorded period, but no recorder file, result or price of it is read; no card's held-out window is touched (NC15DEPTH1's scoring window opens 2026-11-19; the wheel replay reads recorder files, not these candles).
job.notes: Written by the Forensics desk for the Head of R&D's order; owner is MAIN because the runner's owner list has no Forensics entry. One batched request of 11 tickers (the batched endpoint took 24 in CFRTI_K_CANDLES and the WHEEL0 jobs). If the batched endpoint refuses the 11 tickers, the fallback is 11 single GETs one second apart, which needs a second job file (OIFIELD_CHECK_SINGLE) written only if this one fails; none is pre-written. The tickers are the names recorded by NC15 for that window (read from its coverage file: names and close times only). The answer is about 11 markets times 8 candles, well under 1 MB.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
